visual_identity.core_identity: An ancient skeletal spellcaster preserved by forbidden magic, combining unmistakable undead anatomy with deliberate arcane intelligence.
visual_identity.silhouette: Tall robed skeletal humanoid with narrow shoulders, exposed skull and hands, and simple vertical robe shapes.
visual_identity.head_features: Bare or partly hooded skull with deep empty sockets or small magical pinpoints, intact jaw, and severe ancient profile.
visual_identity.body_shape: Dry skeletal humanoid frame under decayed layered robes with bony hands clearly visible.
visual_identity.surface: Clean bone planes and torn fabric edges; no gore, slime, or dense decay.
signature_gear: simple arcane staff or wand if unobtrusive
few ancient jewelry or robe fasteners

accuracy_checks: skull and hands are clearly skeletal
